description: Connect a credential-based social account (telegram, bluesky, discord, wordpress, devto, hashnode, lemmy) directly, without a browser session. Call list_platforms with view=connect_link first to discover the exact credential fields the platform needs. Prefer scoped secrets: app passwords (Bluesky, WordPress), bot tokens (Telegram), webhook URLs (Discord), and API tokens (Dev.to, Hashnode) over primary passwords. Warn the user that any credential they share passes through this conversation. For OAuth platforms (Instagram, X, LinkedIn, ...) use create_connect_session instead.

api_key.description: Dev.to: API key from Settings, Extensions, DEV Community API Keys.

app_password.description: Bluesky: app password from account settings. WordPress: application password from wp-admin Users, Profile, Application Passwords.

chat_id.description: Telegram: target channel or group chat ID.

connect_session_id.description: Optional connect session ID to mark connected or failed based on the outcome.

instance.description: Lemmy: instance domain, for example lemmy.world.

password.description: Lemmy: account password (TOTP-enabled accounts are not supported).

pat.description: Hashnode: personal access token from Account Settings, Developer.

platform.description: Credential-based connection target: telegram, bluesky, discord, wordpress, devto, hashnode, or lemmy.

username.description: WordPress: username the application password belongs to. Lemmy: username or email.

webhook_url.description: Discord: channel webhook URL from channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to connect the account into. Workspace-scoped API keys ignore this.

name: connect_account
